en.text: Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

zhSimplified.text: 神的众子啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的眾子啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華，

en.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

zhSimplified.text: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 妆饰敬拜耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他， 妝飾敬拜耶和華。

en.text: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的声音发在水上；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聲音發在水上；

en.text: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的声音大有能力；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聲音大有能力；

en.text: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的声音震破香柏树； 的香柏树。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聲音震破香柏樹； 的香柏樹。

en.text: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

zhSimplified.text: 他也使之跳跃如牛犊， 和跳跃如野牛犊。

zhTraditional.text: 他也使之跳躍如牛犢， 和跳躍如野牛犢。

en.text: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聲音使火焰分岔。

en.text: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的声音震动旷野； 的旷野。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聲音震動曠野； 的曠野。

en.text: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿落胎， 荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聲音驚動母鹿落胎， 榮耀。

en.text: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. the LORD sits as King forever.

zhSimplified.text: 洪水泛滥之时，耶和华坐着；

zhTraditional.text: 洪水泛濫之時，耶和華坐着；

en.text: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必赐力量给他的百姓；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必賜力量給他的百姓；
